title: Settings
logoSaved: Site logo saved to the database
logoError: Could not save the logo to the database
logoHint: Used in the site header and footer. Leave blank to keep the logo set in the site data.
datesHint: This format applies to record views and editors, admin tables and public pages. Month and weekday names follow the display language.
showTimeHint: Applies when the value includes a time, such as an event start. Dates without a time never show “00:00”.
restockHint: Shown when an order exceeds available stock and the product is not marked as final stock. Variables: {date}, {product}.
codeTokens: Available tokens: {id} = five-digit ID · {year} = two-digit year.
convertHint: Creates the linked order when a quote is accepted.
attachmentHint: Customers must attach a file for items not in the catalog when requesting a quote.
securityHint: Enable two-factor authentication for administrators and image CAPTCHAs for the admin and public site.
admin2faHint: First enable two-factor authentication in your profile by scanning the QR code. This setting then requires it at sign-in.
adminCaptchaHint: Shows an image CAPTCHA on the admin sign-in page.
siteCaptchaHint: Shows an image CAPTCHA on public forms such as contact and registration.
loginToApplyHint: For openings that use the global settings, this determines whether applicants must sign in.
dbHint: The Nest backend uses DATABASE_URL and DB_DRIVER. These fields document the target database for switching drivers.
erpHint: Sales invoices are generated in an external ERP. Fetch them via API or upload them manually to a confirmed, paid order.
erpEnabledHint: Allows invoices to be linked automatically using the ERP API.
requirePaid: Require payment before linking an invoice
requirePaidHint: Prevents linking invoices until the order is confirmed and paid.
autoInvoiceHint: Attempts to fetch the invoice from the ERP as soon as an order is paid.
